SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile AS profile,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS tradeHistoryPublicYn
FROM member m
JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE m.member_role = 'USER' AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE
ORDER BY m.member_id ASC

WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.member_role = 'USER'
